deploy-bot: Heads up — scheduled deploy for `service-users-schema` at 2024-12-03T02:00Z. Automatic holdpoint: `db-migrate-step-3` (requires manual ack in thread).

alice: can we confirm quiet/read-only window for the affected shard? this migration takes an exclusive lock on users.metadata for a short period.

ben: short yes — we should do a 5m exclusive lock window, then stream backfill outside that window. want to pin the app release to v2.14.1 so old reads don't hit the new column yet.

maria: agreed on pin. note the backfill uses a range-copy that can run for 30–90m if we don't chunk. proposing chunked batches of 10k rows with a 5s sleep between batches to avoid replica lag.

alice: sounds good. what's the plan if the exclusive lock stalls? we can't block traffic for >10m.

ben: rollback plan: if lock exceeds 3m, abort migration and revert app pin to v2.14.0, re-open traffic. abort steps are automated in the runbook.

maria: adding nit: use SERIALIZABLE for the short lock step to avoid phantom rows during the swap. but keeps txn time small.

alice: please post the exact SQL + kubectl commands we'll run at the holdpoint so oncall can ack quickly.

maria: SQL snippet we're planning:
```sql
BEGIN;
-- swap column name with minimal downtime
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN metadata SET DATA TYPE jsonb USING metadata::jsonb;
-- exclusive moment: add new column, copy index, then swap
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN metadata_v2 jsonb;
UPDATE users SET metadata_v2 = jsonb_strip_nulls(metadata) WHERE id BETWEEN :start AND :end;
-- rename once verified
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN metadata;
ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN metadata_v2 TO metadata;
COMMIT;
```

maria: kubectl command to ack holdpoint (deploy-bot):
```bash
kubectl annotate deploy service-users-schema deploy/holdpoint-ack=alice --namespace=prod
```

sre_oncall: I'll be watching replica lag and the lock time. if lag > 1000ms or lock > 180s I will trigger the abort path. ping me in thread with ">abort" to escalate.

deploy-bot: holdpoint `db-migrate-step-3` created. To proceed, a human must post `:thumbsup:` and run the ack command. Automated rollback configured: on abort -> re-pin v2.14.0 and run migration cleanup script.

alice: :thumbsup: ack from me. maria, ready to start chunked backfill after the exclusive swap?

maria: starting exclusive swap now, will post progress every 2 batches.

ben: leaving a note here — release notes (internal): "Users schema migration: added JSONB normalization on metadata, chunked backfill to limit replica lag, exclusive swap window <= 5m, rollback path pins app to v2.14.0."

sre_oncall: observed lock time 42s, replica lag peaked at 350ms, continuing monitoring. all good so far.

maria: batch 2/36 complete (10k rows). ETA ~18m for full backfill.

alice: tagging PM & support post-release. will open a follow-up thread for verification of analytics.

deploy-bot: deploy finished and holdpoint released. reminder: runpost checks: `db-checks/migration-verify` and `alert:analytics-diff` scheduled in 10m.
